author.role: independent source and trace bounds review

decision.source_count: HERO fixed256^2 kernel performs 16,777,216 unsigned MAC-loop iterations and 288 copies of16KiB; total payload4.5MiB, intensity32/9MAC/payload-byte. It is not a generic1MAC/word workload.
decision.current_R2_evidence: All post-first-tile dependency releases precede the previous compute DONE. Every intertile gap is exactly1clock, and every non-boundary V-DMA active interval overlaps compute. Existing ordinary startup leaves45clock initial supply offset plus17clock accumulated early compute-span difference relative to solo.
decision.scope: This identifies no observed steady-state input/slot starvation in the fixed one-port/single-multiplier R2. It neither supplies original-eight-PE timing nor disproves residual loss under a different independently supported legal platform or real background lifetime.
decision.next_gate: Obtain only the missing independent source/platform/lifecycle facts listed below before a new performance experiment; no throughput guess, intensity sweep, larger background or new model is requested.
decision.R2_limit: The accepted fixed R2 schedule does not exhaust legal single-port/single-MAC throughput. Branch-specific elapsed conclusions remain accepted; a universal throughput or all-B conclusion would exceed their evidence.

evidence_inputs.classification: source facts plus arithmetic derivations from already accepted records; no reacceptance run

source_facts.fact: Default height=width=256; stripe selection repeatedly halves from128 while stripe bytes>=32KiB, therefore stripe16 and16 stripes.
Two A, two B, two C buffers, each width*stripe_height*sizeof(uint32_t)=16KiB; data buffers require96KiB excluding stacks/runtime/metadata.

Requested OpenMP team8 and three DMA issuing roles do not establish8MAC/clock,8physical memory ports, or3physical DMA engines. Target backend/compiler/service rates are not measured by these declarations.
C=A*B^T using a full width256 inner loop of unsigned multiply+add; default B=2I is an initialization pattern, not a sparse-skipping branch in the kernel.

Source submits future A/B copies, waits current copies, uses an explicit barrier before the parallel compute loop and a loop construct without nowait; current source schedule has synchronization, not an unconstrained future-input oracle.
Last C stripe is copied only after all tiles; the source waits prior C and performs a blocking final copy. It has an unavoidable final-output phase within this invocation.

This source contains its own A/B/C workflow, host reference and target invocation. It contains no independent background DMA application with a sustained rate,8MiB quota, start/deadline, or lifetime requirement.

MACs_total.count_convention: One unsigned multiply-and-add loop iteration, not one ISA instruction or floating-point FLOP. Counting multiply and add separately yields33,554,432 integer algorithm operations.

total_payload.note: Payload is counted once per source-to-destination copy. Adding both source and destination endpoint bytes gives9MiB, a different accounting denominator. Unique A+B+C bytes are768KiB; that is not actual traffic because B is reloaded16times.

arithmetic_intensity.note: This source intensity excludes PTE/PTW traffic, config and local compute reads. Word is explicitly this source uint32=4bytes. It must not be substituted into another paper workload without its workload and word definition.

source_logical_local_accesses.limitation: Logical source accesses do not establish compiled physical SPM transactions; compiler reuse, ports/banks and backend behavior require their own facts.

fixed_R2_resource_bound.status: mathematical consequence of frozen model architecture, not original-HERO hardware performance
fixed_R2_resource_bound.formula: G=2*M +65536 C-word write grants +4718592/8 DMA grants =M*(261/128); at most1 grant/clock => T>=G clocks. One-cycle responses and multiplication/control can only add constraints; this is not an achievable throughput promise.
fixed_R2_resource_bound.note: Merely multiplying PE or multiplier count while keeping these exact separate2-read/MAC single-port rules cannot give8x throughput. A faster design must have independently justified ports, banking/reuse/dataflow and their cost; any such change alters this bound.

evidence.detail: separate A/B64bit read per MAC, C32 strobes

pipeline_scope.reported_source_fact: Root/source seat reports unchanged multiplier.sv ready is constant1 and registers its result each clock. This seat did not add a new source scan after root requested evidence closure.
pipeline_scope.classification: Parent-supplied source capability, not a measured target timing result.
pipeline_scope.R2_is_not_a_throughput_exhaustion_proof: The approximately6model-clocks/MAC scalar R2 loop is a serialized-controller schedule, not an inherent six-cycle multiplier limit. Its approximately100.8M computation clocks do not exhaust every legal same-port/single-MAC schedule.
pipeline_scope.conditional_limit: A correctly tagged operand/multiply/accumulate pipeline could improve ordinary compute scheduling in principle. Compute-only grant budget remains2+1/256 grants/MAC; with all current DMA grants the total bound is261/128 clocks/MAC at one grant/clock. An ideal near2-cycle/MAC steady schedule is not implemented or measured and does not include all stores, DMA, setup and drain.
pipeline_scope.no_new_G0_from_capability_alone: Ready/registered output supplies an engineering possibility, not a faster measured real application, naturally overlapping background, violated copy window, or unique translation remedy. It is insufficient by itself to justify another R3/G1 performance fixture.
pipeline_scope.decision: Keep pipeline legality as a conditional ordinary engineering path. Do not implement a new R3, rerun a model, or infer original-CVA6/eight-PE throughput in this review. Reopening requires the independent platform/application/lifecycle facts already listed and a resulting concrete critical-path failure under an explicit strong ordinary baseline.

dependency_bounds.notation: q=s*16+t; F_q=compute DONE, S_q=command, D_A_s/D_B_q/D_C_s=actual copy DONE, R=earliest contract logical-ready. All quantities use one common time base; q=-1 prior dependency is omitted.
dependency_bounds.release_scope: These are the source-synchronization/frozen-contract releases. A different legal hardware interface might expose last-read retirement earlier than full tile DONE; no such earlier source/controller interface is evidenced here.
dependency_bounds.B_lookahead: For q>=2, two B slots give one intervening-tile window: release F_(q-2), desired next start immediately after F_(q-1). They do not grant two arbitrary future tiles or prefetch before the old same-slot read lifetime ends.
dependency_bounds.A_lookahead: For s>=2, A_s is released after stripe s-2 and needed at stripe s; one intervening complete stripe gives16compute tiles of potential preparation time, shared with other serialized V copies.
dependency_bounds.C_reuse_window: C_s can output only after stripe s completes and must finish before stripe s+2 first tile overwrites the same slot. It has the intervening stripe16tile window, not permission to output future C data before produced.
dependency_bounds.no_extra_supply_bubble_test: For q>=1, if max(D_A_s,D_B_q,D_C_(s-2))<=F_(q-1), no input/slot dependency extends ready beyond prior compute DONE. Controller handshake cost still remains, and DMA can lengthen compute through shared-port contention.
dependency_bounds.critical_copy_residual_condition: A residual supply bubble is possible only if at least one actual required copy/old-output completion exceeds the otherwise legal compute start. Excess of that max dependency over F_(q-1) is a lower bound on the added dependency wait for the fixed order.
dependency_bounds.overlap_interval_bound: With serial compute and serial V DMA, overlap O>=0 and O<=min(C_busy,D_active). Since A0/B0 must complete before first command and final C15 cannot issue before final compute, O<=min(C_busy,D_active-d_A0-d_B0-d_C15) for these actual boundary services. Current four records attain this tighter bound.
dependency_bounds.overall_time_bounds: With independently justified compute service capacity rho and aggregate payload capacity beta in the same time unit, T>=max(M/rho,D/beta), and the DAG adds the initial-input and final-output critical phases. T is not generally max(total compute,total DMA), because starts/releases and a shared SPM couple them. If finite per-task service/control upper bounds exist, a legal serial schedule gives a conservative T<=H+sum(tau_q_max)+sum(d_j_max); without fairness/finite service facts there is no numeric upper bound.
dependency_bounds.steady_average_requirement: Payload averaged across256tiles is18432bytes/tile=16384 B +1024 A +1024 C. If useful compute throughput is rho MAC/time, sustaining that fixed contract requires aggregate beta>=(9/32)*rho payload bytes/time on average, plus per-release-window deadlines. This average is necessary, not sufficient; ports, setup, PTW and queues are not free.

exact_4k_elapsed_decomposition.initial_45_cycles: startup A0 SUBMIT=45 versus solo=0; A0 and B0 issue/done each shift exactly45 with equal actual service duration. This is recorded initial supply/setup offset, not an exclusive PTW cause.

ordinary_startup_boundary.existing_action: Withhold independent BG actual issue until A0/B0 actual DMA DONE and first compute command handshake; keep BG logical-ready=t0; preserve all2048 BG copies and real full finish. This uses no extra slot, extra DMA, free translation or oracle.
ordinary_startup_boundary.current_effect: Prefix input service is protected; subsequent B loads fit one-tile preparation windows. Current startup lowers V finish5944 and BG full finish1191 versus immediate sharing.
ordinary_startup_boundary.not_a_global_BG_latency_dominance: BG first issue/done are48/2055 in immediate versus13597/15604 in startup. First request completes13549 clocks later even though full batch finishes earlier. A real first-packet or per-request deadline could change whether withholding is allowed; no such source deadline is supplied.
limitations: Cannot by itself prepare unknown data before logical release or expand two-slot lifetime windows.
Cannot hide a sustained queue/service delay longer than the legal input/reuse deadline slack.
Cannot overlap the final C output with this invocation after its last compute, unless a different real workflow legally supplies later independent work.
Does not establish a universal optimum for other backgrounds, platforms, or per-request latency constraints.

background_lifetime_boundary.source_status: No independent background lifetime is specified in mm-large.c; the chosen8MiB ring is an external finite research background, not the application demand trace.
background_lifetime_boundary.current_coverage: 4k BG finishes during q7 after only7complete tiles;248tiles have not started. 2m BG finishes during q3 after3complete tiles;252tiles have not started. In every shared case BG finishes before first C output ready. Current runs cannot establish sustained co-running interference during later stripes or terminal output.
background_lifetime_boundary.do_not_overstate: Completion of BG does not logically erase IOTLB replacement history or other persistent state. Those effects may remain, but the matched4k records show no later supply bubble and q>=8 compute durations equal solo. The inherited absolute time shift remains without proving renewed later interference.

conditional_residuals.necessary_legal_condition: Real background has an independently evidenced first-packet/per-request deadline or cannot be withheld while logically ready; or V first inputs are not early known/authorized.
conditional_residuals.why_loss_could_remain: Startup serialization cannot be used unchanged, so cold first-copy service competition can sit on V critical path.
conditional_residuals.current_support: Current record confirms a BG prefix-latency tradeoff but supplies no real deadline; cannot posit one or claim this condition holds.

conditional_residuals.necessary_legal_condition: After safe B_q release, required serialized setup+queue+translation+copy service completes after otherwise-ready q start; background naturally overlaps that phase, or persistent state consumes the available slack.
conditional_residuals.why_loss_could_remain: Two slots supply only one intervening-tile window; faster legal compute with justified local ports/dataflow, slower actual service, or real arrival gaps could exceed it.
conditional_residuals.current_support: No such bubble in any current case. Minimum matched4k B slack to previous compute DONE is382528 clocks. Scaling compute while holding DMA/ports unchanged is only a conditional scenario, not measured evidence.

conditional_residuals.kind: A or C slot lifetime backpressure
conditional_residuals.necessary_legal_condition: A next-generation copy or old C output cannot finish within its intervening-stripe window because of real service/arrival/queue constraints.
conditional_residuals.why_loss_could_remain: Six fixed slots cannot legally overwrite unconsumed input or unfinished output.
conditional_residuals.current_support: Current A/C slack is at least about6.28M/6.295M clocks in matched4k runs; no observed extra dependency wait.

conditional_residuals.kind: compute throughput loss despite timely inputs
conditional_residuals.necessary_legal_condition: DMA and compute contend for a real finite port/bank or other shared service while compute is active, lengthening tau_q even though input DONE precedes use.
conditional_residuals.why_loss_could_remain: Prefetch timeliness is distinct from local compute service. Faster multipliers without matching memory capacity do not remove the one-port grant bound.
conditional_residuals.current_support: Matched4k sums differ18 or17 clocks, localized to q0..7; full traces cannot isolate every-edge cause. These are model elapsed differences, not exclusive IOMMU/PTW attribution.

conditional_residuals.necessary_legal_condition: An independently evidenced real background or persistent shared state delays the actual final-output service after data exists, and a matched baseline establishes the additional service.
conditional_residuals.why_loss_could_remain: There is no further compute in this invocation to hide final output.
conditional_residuals.current_support: BG ends before even C0 is produced. All matched4k final C tails are5023 clocks, so current records show no added terminal elapsed delay.

conditional_residuals.necessary_legal_condition: Actual platform provides enough extra legal local storage/ports and permissions to use a different ordinary reuse scheme.
conditional_residuals.why_loss_could_remain_or_disappear: Caching full B would require256KiB B storage rather than32KiB, plus32KiB A and32KiB C=320KiB total data buffers, an added224KiB over this source. It would change B reload counts and arithmetic intensity.
conditional_residuals.current_support: No evidence here authorizes or times such a platform. It is a resource/accounting boundary, not a free comparison module or a new mechanism claim.
